title: Switch of wing

D0.outcome: Explains switching the attack from one wing to the other after a demonstration has drawn the defenders over.

D1.outcome: In a given position, names the demonstration, the wing it draws defenders to, and the pieces that will switch.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides whether the pieces are mobile enough to switch and whether the opponent is slow to bring defenders.

D3.outcome: Predicts when executing the first threat too early wastes the switch.

misconceptions: Execute every threat as soon as it exists.
conditions: Pieces are mobile enough to switch and the opponent is slow to bring defenders.
contrasts: Executing the threat too early, so the opponent is freed.
Pieces too slow to change wings, so the demonstration only weakens his own side.
A position with play on only one wing.
